:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.8`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noYamlEmptyMapKeys`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`yml/no-empty-key`](https://ota-meshi.github.io/eslint-plugin-yml/rules/no-empty-key.html)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noYamlEmptyMapKeys": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow empty keys in YAML maps.

A key is empty when a map entry has no key, as in `: value`.
A key is also empty when it has only a tag (a type marker that starts with `!`, such as `!!str`)
or an anchor (a name that starts with `&`, used to reuse a value elsewhere), as in `&name : value`.

An empty key is usually a mistake, such as a key name that was deleted or forgotten.
Tools that read the file can reject an empty key, or read it as null or as empty text.

Keys written as empty quoted text, such as `""`, are not reported.

## Examples

### Invalid

```yaml
: value
```

### Valid

```yaml
name: value
"": empty text
? key
: value
settings: { name: value }
```
